FIRST CODICIL TO THE LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT OF SEVERINE ABIODUN-CASTELLANOS

I, Severine Abiodun-Castellanos, of 812 Fernwood Terrace, Providence, Rhode Island, being of sound mind and memory and under no constraint or undue influence, declare this to be the First Codicil to my Last Will and Testament dated March 6, 2021 (my "Will").

ARTICLE I — REPUBLICATION

I republish and reaffirm my Will as amended by this Codicil, and I confirm my Will in all respects except as expressly changed below. This Codicil is to be read together with my Will as one instrument.

ARTICLE II — SUBSTITUTION OF PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE

I revoke Article VII of my Will in its entirety and substitute the following:

"I nominate my sister, Odalys Abiodun, as Personal Representative of my estate. If she is unable or unwilling to serve, I nominate Fairhaven Fiduciary Services, LLC as successor Personal Representative. No Personal Representative shall be required to post bond in any jurisdiction."

ARTICLE III — SPECIFIC BEQUESTS

I revoke the specific bequest in Article III, Paragraph B of my Will of my grandmother's pearl brooch to my niece Delphine Castellanos-Aubert, who predeceased me, and I substitute the following:

"I give my grandmother's pearl brooch to my nephew Ignatius Castellanos-Aubert, if he survives me by thirty (30) days, and if he does not, to my sister Odalys Abiodun."

I add the following specific bequest to Article III of my Will:

"I give my 1968 Fender Jazzmaster guitar and its case to the Providence Youth Music Collective, a Rhode Island nonprofit corporation, or if it is not then in existence, to a comparable charitable organization selected by my Personal Representative."

ARTICLE IV — RESIDUARY

I revoke Article V of my Will in its entirety and substitute the following:

"I give the residue of my estate to my sister Odalys Abiodun, if she survives me by thirty (30) days. If she does not, I give the residue to her descendants who survive me by thirty (30) days, per stirpes. If none survives me, I give the residue to the Providence Community Foundation."

ARTICLE V — GUARDIAN

Article VI of my Will, nominating a guardian for my minor children, is revoked. My children have all attained majority and no guardian nomination is necessary.

ARTICLE VI — CONFIRMATION

In all other respects I confirm my Will as previously executed. Except as changed by this Codicil, every provision of my Will remains in full force and effect, including the tax-apportionment clause in Article VIII and the no-contest clause in Article IX.

I have signed this First Codicil on September 12, 2026, at Providence, Rhode Island.

/s/ Severine Abiodun-Castellanos
Severine Abiodun-Castellanos, Testator

ATTESTATION

The foregoing instrument was signed by the Testator in our presence, and the Testator declared it to be a Codicil to the Testator's Last Will and Testament. At the Testator's request, in the Testator's presence, and in the presence of each other, we now sign our names as witnesses. Each of us is over eighteen years of age, is competent to be a witness, and is not a beneficiary under the Will or this Codicil. We believe the Testator to be of sound mind and under no constraint or undue influence.

/s/ Cornelius Van Zandt-Oyelaran
Cornelius Van Zandt-Oyelaran, 44 Angell Street, Providence, Rhode Island

/s/ Marguerite Delacroix-Sundberg
Marguerite Delacroix-Sundberg, 19 Benefit Street, Providence, Rhode Island

SELF-PROVING AFFIDAVIT

STATE OF RHODE ISLAND, COUNTY OF PROVIDENCE

We, Severine Abiodun-Castellanos, Cornelius Van Zandt-Oyelaran, and Marguerite Delacroix-Sundberg, the Testator and the witnesses respectively, whose names are signed to the foregoing instrument, having been sworn, declared to the undersigned officer that the Testator signed the instrument as a Codicil to the Testator's Will, that the Testator signed willingly and executed it as a free and voluntary act, and that each witness, in the presence and hearing of the Testator, signed the Codicil as witness and to the best of the witness's knowledge the Testator was at that time eighteen years of age or older, of sound mind, and under no constraint or undue influence.

Subscribed and sworn before me on September 12, 2026.

/s/ Beatriz Nakamura-Hollingsworth
Beatriz Nakamura-Hollingsworth, Notary Public
